explanation: Memoize edit distances between prefixes. Equal final characters inherit the diagonal result; otherwise try substitution, insertion and deletion and add one. Empty-prefix base cases supply the remaining length.
spaceComplexity: O(mn) memo storage plus O(m+n) recursion space.
